title: Coverage Waiting Periods for HomeFlood Policies
content:
The waiting periods scheduled for **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies**, counted in calendar days, are:

| Tier | Standard waiting period (days) | Waiting period for a home purchase or refinance closing (days) | Waiting period when replacing an NFIP policy with no gap (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| HomeFlood Essential | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| HomeFlood Standard | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| HomeFlood Plus | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| HomeFlood Premier | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| HomeFlood Estate | 14 | 0 | 0 |

- **Standard waiting period** — runs from the date the application and first payment are received to the day coverage attaches, and applies to mid-term increases in the same way.
- **Closing waiting period** — applies when the policy is bought for a home purchase or refinance closing and is received no later than the closing date.
- **NFIP replacement waiting period** — applies when the policy replaces an NFIP policy on the same building with no gap in coverage.

*Hypothetical illustration:* with the standard 14 days, an application and first payment received on the 3rd of a month lead to coverage attaching on the 17th of that month.
